spans.text: This just in—
There was a malfunction at the quarantine wall to the southeast of the city yesterday.
The monitoring station's report indicates that the malfunction did not result in a leak of Collapse Particles, so there is little cause for concern.
A maintenance team has been dispatched to inspect and repair the malfunction...
More breaking news.
There has been an unexplained explosion at the Gray Institute of Biotechnology. The exterior wall of the institute has suffered minor damage...
We are handing over to Shadowless, who has arrived at the scene.
Right!
This suspected attack hasn't caused any casualties, but according to a worker, Mrs. Gray has gone missing since the explosion.
The rescue party has been searching for her, but to no avail so far.
The rescuers have also discovered that the explosion was very likely caused by the use of explosives. In other words, it may have been an intentional attack...
Oh!
This place is now sealed off. Please leave.
Hold on, we're from the DRF. May I ask who...
We are under orders to evict all press. Please leave at once, or we will be forced to take stronger measures!
Main station, we are being sent away. They're probably from the Ministry of Security.
The entire institute has been sealed off, and all reporters, including us, have been asked to leave at once.
But I'm used to this—they do this a lot.
We are planning to... What? Wha...
Right...
Another explosion just occurred in the nearby Galatea medical storage facility, and the scene is in utter chaos.

According to my fellow correspondent already at the scene, Galatea Corporation has immediately held a press conference after the incident. They claim that it was a premeditated attack and denounce the hidden orchestrator.
However...the police seems to be interrupting the press conference...
We'll be heading over right away to bring you the latest news!
